response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points AS pts FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), per_race AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(pts) AS avg_pts FROM kept GROUP BY race_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.race_name, p.avg_pts AS average, p.avg_pts - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_pts > o.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Each driverStandings row joins to exactly one race through races.raceId, and the filter ds.points > 1.0 is applied to the stored season-to-date value, as the request specifies. NULL points are excluded by that filter.
Race names are grouped across all seasons, so every year's 'Monaco Grand Prix' rows form one group, as the request's 'for each race name' implies.
The per-race-name averages are combined with an unweighted mean, one value per name. If no names remain, the overall average is NULL and the query returns no rows.
The query was written from the schema and was not executed against the database here, so its output is unverified.
